rca of the issue: Point 8 root cause: /app/frontend/src/pages/AdminDashboard.js has the section handler `{section === 'suggestions' && <Suggestions/>}` (line 203) and the full <Suggestions> component (line 1180+), but the NAV constant (lines 33-43) does NOT contain a 'suggestions' entry. The <NavButtons> sidebar iterates NAV to render buttons, so with no entry there's no way for the user to setSection('suggestions'). Fix: append `{ key: 'suggestions', label: 'Suggestions IA', Icon: Sparkles }` (Sparkles already imported line 23) to NAV — this will automatically generate the [data-testid='nav-suggestions'] button expected by the spec.
